criteria.evidence: cmdNew calls syncHeader. The AC1 CLI test checks the exact heading, blank line and draft status; the emoji test exercises all seven status mappings.
writeField synchronises the header. The AC2 integration test exercises adding a missing header, changing the title and shipping with the done status.
lintTicket compares the heading and status line with ticketHeader. The AC3 test covers both missing fields and each stale field.

cmdInit synchronises tickets in both live and done folders. The AC4 integration test covers correction, body preservation and repeated init. The new F1 regression test checks complete output and idempotence for missing and stale headers with blank lines, indentation and nested list content. The supplied repository diff includes headers on all seven tickets.

findings.issue: The previous header parser consumed whitespace belonging to the ticket body.
findings.suggested_fix: Implemented: line-based parsing preserves the remaining body, with exact-output regression tests covering indentation and extra blank lines.

product_md.note: The living spec accurately describes header creation, synchronisation, lint warnings and migration.

verdict.summary: The whitespace-loss issue is fixed and covered by meaningful regression tests. All four acceptance criteria are met, with no remaining blocking findings. The supplied results show 47 passing tests; independent execution remains unavailable because the sandbox failed to start.
